parameters.name: schema
parameters.description: Optional DB schema that overrides the schema specified in the connection. Make sure that if you change the schema parameter value in the constructor of the derived Hook, such change should be done before calling the ``DBApiHook.__init__()``.

parameters.name: log_sql
parameters.description: Whether to log SQL query when it's executed. Defaults to *True*.

parameters.name: database
parameters.description: Optional database name. Overrides the ``schema`` field of the Airflow connection. Useful when one connection points to a ClickHouse cluster and individual tasks need to target different databases.

parameters.name: session_settings
parameters.description: Optional dict of ClickHouse session-level settings (e.g. ``{"max_execution_time": 60, "max_threads": 4}``). Values supplied here are **merged on top of** any ``session_settings`` dict already present in the connection's ``extra`` JSON field, with the constructor argument taking precedence. For a full list of available session settings visit https://clickhouse.com/docs/operations/settings/settings

parameters.name: client_kwargs
parameters.description: Optional dict of additional keyword arguments forwarded verbatim to ``clickhouse_connect.get_client()``. Use this to pass any parameter not otherwise exposed by the hook (e.g. ``http_proxy``, ``pool_mgr_params``). Values supplied here are **merged on top of** any ``client_kwargs`` dict already present in the connection's ``extra`` JSON field, with the constructor argument taking precedence on conflicting keys. Keys that the hook manages itself (``host``, ``port``, ``username``, ``password``, ``database``, ``secure``, ``verify``, ``client_name``, ``settings``) are silently ignored so that hook-managed values always take precedence.
